content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge decides a pressed-link issue by asking whether the verse’s own words state the contrary, which is the kind of verse-by-verse stating-verse test K-C governs and retires.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the verb change is real [L1]/[L2] but neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "none", "why": "The judge treats the absence of a verse whose own words state the contrary as making the link underdetermined, instead of weighing the pressed chain against the defender’s chain by footing as K-C requires."}
